name: Take Out
source:
"Take Out" is an emotion-driven visual novel and rhythm adventure about 30 days with Morning, an android delivered to your home. Your choices shape your bond, while each day's emotions unfold in webtoon-style cutscenes and rhythm gameplay as she grows from a household assistant into a band vocalist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175110/TAKE_OUT/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《外卖》是一部情感驱动的视觉小说和节奏冒险游戏，时长约30天，由机器人Morning送货上门。你的选择塑造了你们的联系，而随着她从家庭助理成长为乐队主唱，每天的情感都会在网络漫画风格的过场动画和节奏游戏中展开。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175110/TAKE_OUT/]Steam[/url]]
